How to play
AimDrag left or right on the upper screen. Tap Map and tap a spot to aim straight at it.
SwingOn the lower pad, drag down to take the club back (the arc shows power), then swipe up fast through your start point. A straight swipe flies straight; a curved one draws or fades. Past the arc's end is an overswing: more power, less control.
TempoSmooth and committed. Rushing the downswing opens the face; decelerating loses distance.
PuttDrag down to set the pace (the readout shows the flat-roll distance), then release. Use Read to see the slope and −/+ to change the putt range.
ClubsThe caddie picks a club for every lie. Use ◀ ▶ to change it.
RulesOut of bounds: stroke and distance. Water: drop (+1) or replay (+1). Pick up at double par.
